note: The neutral window («Записник сталкера», the mockup's loner): a clean notebook spread on a wooden desk. Left page ruled: title, the pool as plain numbers, the entry of the selected node; right page squared: the tree growing down, branch name and line on top, the legend below. Root TreeWindow fills the screen with the desk; TreeStage is the mockup's 1600x900 stage, centred. Roles the menu fills are listed in source/ui/SKINS.md; numbers are the mockup's, measured in Chrome.

image.name: TreeDesk
image.note: Wood, tiled at its own size over the whole screen.

image.name: SpreadShadow
image.note: The notebook's shadow on the desk.

panel.name: PoolHeadLine
panel.note: The underline of the heading; the skin sizes it to the word.

list.name: PoolScroll
list.note: Five lines on the ruling; a faction with more lines scrolls.

row.name: OZL_NeutralPoolRow
row.note: One line of the pool: its name and the number, right-aligned; a zero is crossed out (the strikes are sized by the skin to the text).

list.name: CardScroll
list.note: The node's entry, top to bottom; the engine stacks it and a long entry scrolls above the button.

row.name: OZL_NeutralCostRow
row.note: A cost line of the card: the name and 'have / need' (or 'need' alone when paid or not known); what is short is underlined. Paper skins show no chip and no bar here.

row.name: OZL_NeutralOpensChip
row.note: A node this one opens: a word with a dashed underline. The menu lines the chips up and stretches ChipHit and ChipLine to each chip's width; a hidden node's chip has no ChipHit.

raw.name: ChipHit
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

icon.name: CardNameWave
icon.note: The wavy underline of the name; the skin stretches it to the name.

stack.name: CardMeta
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines (bitmap fonts: no MultilineTextWidget).

stack.name: CardDesc
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines, 32 apart like the ruling.

frame.name: CardSegs
frame.note: The 20 segments of a running project: an underline each, red when done.

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The menu lines the 'opens' chips up here (ozl_neutral_opens_chip) and sets the height to what they take.

panel.name: BtnResearchHover
panel.note: The pale ink under an enabled button the mouse is over.

icon.name: BtnResearchRing
icon.note: Circled in ink: shown while the button is enabled.

raw.name: BtnResearch
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

panel.name: BtnResearchStrike
panel.note: Strikes the words of a disabled button; the skin sizes it to the words.

icon.name: PageGlow
icon.note: The soft light on the paper.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The tree: drag it, or the wheel. The menu sizes TreeContent.

image.name: TreeBg
image.note: Shown only with the admin's own TreeBackground (the menu loads it); the paper's squares are drawn on TreeLines.

raw.name: TreeLines
raw.note: The squares of the paper and every link, drawn by the menu.

raw.name: BtnClose
raw.note: Not in the mockup: the paper has no frame to close, so a pencilled word in the corner.

list.name: BranchScroll
list.note: Only when the faction has more than one branch (the skin shows it).

row.name: OZL_NeutralBranchRow
row.note: A branch: RowHit is clicked (the menu renames it branch:<id>); the open one is underlined in red.

list.name: TreeTemplates
list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the row files the menu creates outside the lists.

row.name: OZL_NeutralTierLabel
row.note: A tier label; the menu puts the row's corner on the label's centre.

row.name: OZL_NeutralOrLabel
row.note: The 'АБО' beside an 'any' diamond; the menu puts the row's corner on the diamond and colours the word like its line.

row.name: OZL_NeutralPriceChip
row.note: One line of a node's price: its coloured dot and the amount. The menu lines them up in NodePrice.
